title: DXA-measured lean and fat mass differences with incretin-based therapy versus comparators: analysis code and data (version 2.1, second revision for BMC Endocrine Disorders)
description: Data and R code for the systematic review and meta-analysis of phase 3 randomized trials reporting DXA-derived lean body mass and fat mass with GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists (PROSPERO CRD420261323497). Version 2.1 (September/October 2026) accompanies the second revised manuscript submitted to BMC Endocrine Disorders. No extracted value changed from version 2.0. The principal presentation is now stratified by population and comparator type, the five-trial pooled estimate is a secondary summary, and the meta-regression, small-study tests and pooled lean proportion were withdrawn. New at 2.1: the RoB 2 assessment against the specific estimand synthesized (rob2/), searches of trial registries and sponsor repositories for unpublished DXA outcomes (searches/), and the independent human audit of data extraction (audit/). The analysis (glp1_dxa_meta_v1_3.R, revision_analyses.R, refresh_forests_v1_3.R) implements the REML + Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman primary model, prediction intervals, tau-squared estimator comparison, profile-likelihood intervals, robust variance estimation, a three-level model, leave-one-out and expanded-inclusion analyses, and Bayesian random-effects models (brms, bayesmeta) with prior sensitivity. All outputs (tables, figures, console log) are included; see README.md and CHANGELOG.md.
